Package robbery.outpost

Class OutpostRegion

java.lang.Object
robbery.outpost.OutpostRegion
public class OutpostRegion extends Object
Represents a rectangular cuboid region in a specific world, used for defining Outpost boundaries.

The region is defined by two sets of coordinates (x1, y1, z1) and (x2, y2, z2). The constructor automatically calculates the minimum and maximum values for each axis.
